sources.excerpt: Official Dirty Habit DC homepage identifies the Penn Quarter restaurant at 555 8th Street NW.
Official current menu hub describes seasonal global cuisine and links current menu services, but does not expose a product allergen matrix.

Exact-address structured menu feed underlying the freeze; inspected for all food, nonalcoholic, and alcohol presentations. It is not treated as direct allergen authority.
Recent owner-supplied menu images, updated days ago, corroborate current breakfast, brunch, lunch, dinner, dessert, happy-hour and nonalcoholic scope.
Targeted exact-location search found official menu hub and third-party menu mirrors but no restaurant-issued product allergen matrix.

summary: Dirty Habit identity is confirmed at 555 8th Street NW. The exact-address catalog contains 74 food/nonalcoholic products after excluding 20 alcohol-only rows. All 94 frozen rows reconcile once. All four allergen searches are complete; no official matrix or cross-contact guide exists publicly, and third-party ingredient-derived signals are conservatively treated as unavailable rather than direct evidence.
proposedChanges: Publish the 74-item food/nonalcoholic boundary and remove wine, champagne, whiskey, port and boozy-brunch rows.
Reset unsupported third-party ingredient-derived direct allergen fields to unavailable; infer no absences.
